diagnosis: Customer asks about v1 reporting retirement. Per kb-0007, v1 reporting endpoints stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01; migration path is v2 with same fields under a paginated envelope. No escalation needed.
reply: Thanks for reaching out! Yes, the v1 reporting endpoints are scheduled to stop accepting traffic on 2026-11-01. We recommend migrating to v2, which returns the same fields but wrapped in a paginated envelope, so your dashboard may need small adjustments to handle pagination. Please let us know if you have questions during the migration.
